## Extra Resources/Reading

- [SC Ch 16 - Programming with Data](https://srvanderplas.github.io/stat-computing-r-python/part-gen-prog/07-prog-data.html) - data explorations worked out with R/tidyverse code. You don't know how to do graphics yet, but hopefully the data operations make sense.
- [Tidy Tuesday Screencasts](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5ub92c-5xFQ&list=PL19ev-r1GBwkuyiwnxoHTRC8TTqP8OEi8) (YouTube, David Robinson). These show example data analyses in real time, with commentary, using a new dataset each week. These were primarily recorded during the pandemic, but are still an incredibly valuable resource for learing how to work with data.
- [Allison Horst's Tidyverse Illustrations](https://allisonhorst.com/r-packages-functions) - mostly illustrates tidyverse functions. 
- [Functional Programming Illustrations](https://allisonhorst.com/wickham-tidy-bakers)
